title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
authors: R. Nakano, J. Hilton, S. Balaji, et al. (18 authors)
before: Models answered from their weights alone, with no way to check anything.
problem: Long-form answers were unsourced and often confidently wrong.
breakthrough: Give the model a text browser, train it with human feedback to search, navigate and cite, then answer.
why: The first real tool-using language model, and the ancestor of every research and browsing agent.
next: ReAct formalised the loop; Toolformer learned tool calls without demonstrations.
inherits: The model that acts in an environment rather than only emitting text.
